text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait for our picnic, 
Phalaenopsis! ♪

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I looked into the park, and 
from 1 p.m. the wild bird plaza and the 
animal petting area 
are open!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
So after we eat lunch by the flowers, 
let's go to the bird plaza, pet the 
animals, 
and buy souvenirs at the limited-time 
shop~!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You're quite eager about this. 
I'm grateful you looked into so many 
things.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I'm always leaning on you, after 
all! 
This time I did my best in my own way!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm most grateful. 
However, according to what I found—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The petting area appears to be open 
only until 3 p.m. Perhaps we should go 
there first, 
and see the birds afterward?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's do that... 
Uuu, sorry—I ended up relying on you after 
all~!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Think nothing of it. That a limited-time 
souvenir stall 
was even there, I did not know either.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Since we are at it, 
pick out some sweets that look good. 
You are confident in your palate, are you 
not?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—! Yes, of course! 
And I'm good at carrying bags, too! 
I'll carry everything we buy, no problem! 
♪

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I don't intend to buy all that much, 
but... hehe, 
I'll be counting on you. Then I leave the 
day to you.
